learning.title: Verification memory admission is an available-memory floor, not a virtual-memory cap
learning.trigger: Heavy checks require at least 3145728 KiB of MemAvailable.
learning.mistake: Using ulimit -v 3145728 prevented Deno Oilpan from reserving its cage and caused WebAssembly reservation failures. A private lock also failed to serialize against other verification owners.
learning.rule: Use one internal flock -w 900 on /run/user/1000/bakery-verification.lock. While holding it, read numeric MemAvailable from /proc/meminfo before every heavy command and require at least 3145728 KiB. Preserve normal virtual-memory limits and existing browser/test timeouts. Tool timeout must cover the queue plus the finite job. Never use nested locks or an unguarded check after a free-slot probe.

verification.requirement: Ordered pnpm fmt starts successfully with normal unlimited virtual memory after numeric floor admission; no Oilpan reservation failure. Record the available-memory value and command exit, not an inferred pass.
